name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-generated presentations that actually look like a human made them.
problem: Most AI presentation tools produce generic, visually cluttered slides that undermine credibility and require heavy manual cleanup. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the gap between speed and quality, letting teams produce polished, on-brand decks without sacrificing aesthetic integrity. It removes the trade-off between using AI assistance and delivering professional output.
useCases: Creating investor pitch decks with a refined, non-templated look
Building sales enablement materials at scale without designer bottlenecks
Producing internal strategy presentations quickly for leadership reviews
Turning written reports or briefs into structured visual presentations
